title: ProgressionClass
description: RPG progression core: classes, growth, and long-term motivation that feels like an MMO.
body:
# Progression

Progression is what turns a “server with plugins” into a real RPG experience. Players don’t just collect gear—they build a role, grow over time, and feel that every session moves them forward. If you want your server to feel like an MMO with structure, identity, and a reason to keep playing, this is the backbone.

Highlights:

Class-based gameplay (identity, role, direction)

Progression designed for long-term retention

Built to connect cleanly with quests, items, shops, and more

Perfect for: MMO/RPG servers, class systems, progression networks.

# Why you’ll love it

Turns your server into a real RPG/MMO experience

Players build a role/identity, not just gear

Creates a “one more session” progression loop

# Features

Class-based gameplay (choose a role, build your playstyle)

Long-term progression designed for retention

UI-driven, guided experience

Built to integrate with quests, shops, items, enchants, dungeons

# Setup

Install the plugin

Configure classes/progression values

Hook it into your ecosystem (quests, shops, etc.) if used

Fine-tune balancing (XP rates, unlock pacing)

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Works great with: quests, NPCs, shops, tool progression, custom items

Storage: depends on config (YAML/MySQL where supported)
